extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to show that repeated tank rows enter the row-independent test despite the report's claim. Traced the full data path: read_sessions yields 46 session tuples, collapse_to_tanks reduces them to 12 tank dictionaries keyed by tank_id, group_means selects only the single mean_mo2 per tank, and mannwhitneyu receives exactly those 6-element arrays; no other code path passes session-level values to any test. I then recomputed the tank means from the CSV (verifying T01 = 209.75, T05 = 657.9/3 = 219.30, T10 = 699.3/3 = 233.10, etc.), derived U = 34 by counting cross-group pairs, and computed the exact two-sided p as 8/924 = 0.008658 and rank-biserial 0.889 — identical to the reported values. A row-level test on 25 vs 21 sessions would have produced a much larger U and a different p, so the reported numbers are only reproducible from the collapsed tank means. The falsification attempt failed; the sample size claimed and used is one value per independent unit.
